summary: Opened a new persistence/progress question after closing the ReadIndex authority account. Sources show how snapshot save failures are classified in node.doSave (abort versus soft versus hard error), that node.save reports the pending request only after doSave returns a value, and the exact conditions gating a periodic snapshot request including the requested-index advance. The unresolved point, registered as the investigation discriminator and a gap, is whether a hard save error clears the saving state and the requested index so later periodic snapshots and automatic log compaction stay available; no defect is claimed yet and no execution was run.
